alias: Music: the Show's volume buttons move the speaker that's playing
description: When music plays on a speaker other than the Kitchen Echo (the Family Room Stereo's WiiM, the HomePod or the basement), each press of the Echo's volume buttons steps that speaker's volume 2% up or down. The speaker is the one the Music pop-up is pointed at (input_text.music_speaker), and only while it is playing. The Whole House group is left to whole_house_show_buttons_volume (the Echo is in that group). The Echo's own volume still moves too: the buttons act on it before Home Assistant hears the press. Ty, 2026-11-04: eight presses during 'good morning music' raised only the Echo.

conditions.value_template: {{ trigger.from_state is not none and trigger.from_state.state not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] and trigger.to_state.state not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] }}

{% set p = states('input_text.music_speaker') %}{{ p in ['media_player.family_room_stereo', 'media_player.homepod', 'media_player.basement_stereo'] and is_state(p, 'playing') and not is_state('media_player.whole_house', ['playing', 'paused']) }}
